sb-gotour2026-gold.notes: Johto day, Tue 24 Feb 2026. Ethan's Hat and Lyra's Hat Pikachu (1-star) Gold or Silver; Shadow Ho-Oh (5-star Shadow raids) Gold. Ho-Oh is only the Shadow one (Purified later keeps it); Serebii's plain Ho-Oh is wrong. How it worked (official post): raid bosses 'will have a chance of receiving new Special Backgrounds after making a successful catch in all raids'; Timed and Field Research Pokémon don't get them. One region per day (Mon 23 Kanto, Tue 24 Johto, Wed 25 Hoenn, Thu 26 Sinnoh, Fri 27 Feb 2026 Unova), from the 1-star costume-Pikachu raids and the 5-star / Shadow / Primal legendary raids. The legendary always gets its fixed version; the costume Pikachu can get either, and no source says how that is picked (presumably random per catch; not by player choice). Remote raids aren't excluded anywhere.

sb-gotour2026-x.choice: Yes, two ways: the Kalos starter was the player's pick (one of Chespin/Fennekin/Froakie, getting both X and Y); the guaranteed Xerneas came only on the X path of the ticketed research. Raid Pikachu, Honedge and Xerneas weren't path-locked as far as sources say.
sb-gotour2026-x.notes: List confirmed by Leek Duck, GO Hub and Serebii (Pikachu in Calem's/Serena's Hat and Honedge from 1-star raids, Xerneas/Yveltal from 5-star raids, 28 Feb-1 Mar 2026). Kalos starters: promo code GOTOURKALOS (redeem by 2 Mar 2026, research open to 8 Mar) gave Timed Research where you chose ONE of Chespin, Fennekin or Froakie and got six encounters alternating X, Y, X, Y, X, Y (Nintendo Wire), three of each background; that is why she has Fennekin with both. Pikachu and Honedge: every source lists them under both X and Y and none says the X/Y path decides it, so not version-locked as far as anyone says (probably random per catch; not confirmed). Xerneas and Yveltal raids were open to both paths. For her (Y path, Fennekin): X possible on raid Pikachu, Honedge, raid Xerneas and Fennekin; not on Chespin or Froakie.

sb-gotour2026-y.choice: Yes: starter pick as for X; the guaranteed Yveltal came only on the Y path (her path: she has the Y Yveltal).

sb-gotour2026-mega.notes: Kalos Global (28 Feb-1 Mar 2026) Mega and Super Mega raid list matches Leek Duck (Dragonite was a Super Mega Raid both days; Serebii simply leaves it out). Mega Ascension (31 Aug-4 Sep) and Mega Finale (5-6 Sep 2026) confirmed by pokemongo.com and Leek Duck ('Pokémon caught from Mega Raids ... may have a Mega Evolution-themed Special Background'). Serebii's Mega Finale page shows Mewtwo with this same Mega background, so Mega Finale Mewtwo belongs here. Leek Duck lists Chespin/Fennekin/Froakie as 'Kalos first partners from GO Pass' on that page, but Serebii shows them as GO Pass rewards with no background: doubtful. Serebii also lists Gligar, which can't come from a Mega Raid: ignore. The evening return of the Road to Kalos raids at Kalos Global (6-8:30 pm) isn't said to give any background.
